title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.57: Fixed the crash (stack overflow) when a Tuned Spectacle was in play - Spectacle's target type infinitely recursed because it scanned every Tuned card's target type, including its own. Now re-entrancy-guarded like the other Planned/Tuned resolvers. Removed the v1.13.56 diagnostic.
